summary: The Camp Washington Skatepark on Stock Ave, documented as built in August 2026 for the Cincinnati Recreation Commission: a site plan, a 3D massing model and an exploded axon. Hunger Skateparks designed the park. The CRC work also covers GIS inventory and analysis across city recreation sites, and planting installation in the field.
